metadata.description: Skills, commands and agents for Claude Code: design principles, modern PHP, Laravel.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Design principles (SOLID, DRY, YAGNI, SSOT), ADR writing, and a developer agent with clean-code preloaded.

plugins.name: php
plugins.description: Modern PHP 8.4+, PHP projects for shared hosting, and a php-developer agent with clean-code and modern-php preloaded.

plugins.name: laravel
plugins.description: Laravel architecture (layers, modules, framework components, Action vs Service, internal packages), Ziggy to Wayfinder migration, and a laravel-developer agent with clean-code, modern-php and laravel-architecture preloaded.

plugins.name: cost
plugins.description: Shows the session's API-equivalent cost (USD, list price) above the prompt, with a per-model cost breakdown on click, even on a subscription plan.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks git writes in projects you lock with /git-lock, protects migrations already in git, and asks before destructive database and file commands, writes to protected branches, git remote operations, deploys and publishes.
